name: B-52H Stratofortress
summary: Eight-engine long-range strategic bomber that has served since the 1950s and is planned to fly into the 2050s with new engines.

wings: High-mounted, long swept wing that droops noticeably when parked
Small outrigger wheels near the wingtips
Large external fuel tanks under the outer wings
engines: Eight engines in four paired pods hung under the wings
Older low-bypass engines with long, slender nacelles, often trailing smoke
fuselage: Long slab-sided fuselage with bicycle-style main landing gear
Blunt nose with two blister sensor turrets underneath
tail: Very tall, square-topped single vertical fin
Large horizontal tail set low on the rear fuselage

tellTales: Eight engines in four paired pods under the wings
Tall slab fin and drooping high wings with outrigger wheels near the tips
Two blister turrets under a blunt nose

confusedWith.howToTell: The B-52 has fixed, high-mounted wings with eight engines in four pods and a tall slab fin; the B-1B is sleek with swing wings and engines paired under the body.
The B-52 has eight engines in pairs on a high wing; the KC-135 has four single engines on a low wing and a refueling boom.
